```yaml
name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  debug-environment:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Log Environment Details
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Details ==="
          echo "Runner OS: ${{ runner.os }}"
          echo "Runner Arch: ${{ runner.arch }}"
          echo "GitHub Ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "GitHub Sha: ${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "GitHub Actor: ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "GitHub Event: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "Repository: ${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "Workspace: ${{ github.workspace }}"
          echo "Path: ${{ github.path }}"

      - name: Log Auth Status
        run: |
          echo "=== Auth Status ==="
          if [ -n "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" ]; then
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is set: true"
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN length: $(echo -n "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | wc -c)"
          else
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is set: false"
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN length: 0"
          fi
          
          # Check if we can read the repo
          echo "Testing git read access..."
          git ls-remote --heads origin > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Git read access: OK" || echo "Git read access: FAILED"

      - name: Log Branch Protection Rules
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules ==="
          # Use GitHub CLI to fetch branch protection rules
          # Note: This requires the token to have admin:repo_hook or write:contents permissions depending on scope
          # Since we only have read permissions in this workflow, this might fail, which is part of the debug info
          
          echo "Checking protection rules for branch: $BRANCH"
          
          RESPONSE=$(gh api repos/"$REPO"/branches/"$BRANCH"/protection 2>&1) || true
          
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "API Request Failed or No Protection Rules:"
            echo "$RESPONSE"
          else
            echo "API Response:"
            echo "$RESPONSE" | jq .
            
            if echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e '.enforce_admins' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Enforce Admins: $(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.enforce_admins.enabled')"
            fi
            
            if echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e '.required_status_checks' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Required Status Checks: $(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.required_status_checks.enabled')"
            fi
            
            if echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e '.required_pull_request_reviews' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Required PR Reviews: $(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.required_pull_request_reviews.enabled')"
            fi
            
            if echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e '.restrictions' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Push Restrictions: $(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.restrictions.enabled')"
              if echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e '.restrictions.users' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "Allowed Users: $(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.restrictions.users[].login' | tr '\n' ', ')"
              fi
              if echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e '.restrictions.teams' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "Allowed Teams: $(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.restrictions.teams[].slug' | tr '\n' ', ')"
              fi
            fi
          fi

      - name: Test Push Capability (Dry Run)
        run: |
          echo "=== Push Capability Test ==="
          echo "Attempting to create a test commit (will not push)..."
          
          # Create a dummy file to test if we can stage changes
          echo "debug-test-$(date +%s)" > debug-test-file.txt
          git add debug-test-file.txt
          
          if git status --porcelain | grep -q "debug-test-file.txt"; then
            echo "Staging changes: OK"
          else
            echo "Staging changes: FAILED"
          fi
          
          # Try to commit
          git config user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config user.email "actions@github.com"
          
          if git commit -m "Debug test commit"; then
            echo "Creating commit: OK"
          else
            echo "Creating commit: FAILED"
          fi
          
          # Clean up
          git reset --hard HEAD~1
          rm -f debug-test-file.txt

      - name: Summary
        run: |
          echo "=== Debug Summary ==="
          echo "This workflow helps diagnose push permission issues."
          echo "Check the logs above for:"
          echo "1. Environment details"
          echo "2. Auth status and token validity"
          echo "3. Branch protection rules"
          echo "4. Push capability test results"
          echo ""
          echo "If push is failing, check:"
          echo "- Does the GITHUB_TOKEN have write permissions?"
          echo "- Are there branch protection rules blocking pushes?"
          echo "- Is the branch protected with required reviews or status checks?"
          echo "- Are there push restrictions limiting who can push?"
```
